import copy,datetime,json,re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.envs import pair_v2_fixed_labels as labels
name='diag_current_look_inventory_01'
allowed={'src.tools.t01v2_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_controller_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_look_unit_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_flip_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_flip_rounds_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_flip_ranked_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_stay_priority_review_checkpoint','src.tools.t01v2_g01_review_checkpoint'}
source_cache={}; current=[]; historical=[]; scan=[]
for path in sorted((merge.ROOT/'results').glob('*checkpoint*.json')):
 initial=json.loads(path.read_text())
 if initial.get('metrics',{}).get('kind')!='t01v2_review_checkpoint':continue
 checkpoint,checkpoint_ref=audited_result(path)
 cfg,m,meta=checkpoint['config'],checkpoint['metrics'],checkpoint['_meta']
 command=meta['command']; modules=[module for module in allowed if module in command]
 if len(modules)!=1:raise ValueError('Unknown independent checkpoint producer: '+str(path))
 args=merge.producer_arguments(command,modules[0])
 if merge.option(args,'--name')!=meta['name'] or cfg['name']!=meta['name']:raise ValueError('Checkpoint producer/name mismatch')
 eligible=meta.get('exit_code')==0 and bool(meta.get('end')) and m.get('errors')==[] and m.get('status') in ('checkpoint_ready_for_human_review','checkpoint_no_qualified_pairs')
 scan.append({'checkpoint':checkpoint_ref,'module':modules[0],'eligible_published_checkpoint':eligible,'status':m.get('status'),'errors':m.get('errors'),'published_pair_count':m.get('published_pair_count')})
 if not eligible:continue
 if len(m['candidate_pairs'])!=m['published_pair_count']:raise ValueError('Published checkpoint inventory mismatch')
 for row in m['candidate_pairs']:
  if row.get('kind') not in ('look_flip','look_stay'):continue
  source_file=row['source_file']
  if source_file not in source_cache:source_cache[source_file]=audited_result(merge.ROOT/source_file)
  source,source_ref=source_cache[source_file]
  refs=[ref for ref in checkpoint['sources'] if ref.get('file')==source_file]
  if len(refs)!=1 or any(refs[0].get(k)!=source_ref.get(k) for k in ('file','sha256','metrics_sha256','git_commit','exit_code')):raise ValueError('Checkpoint original source reference changed')
  if row['source_sha256']!=source_ref['sha256'] or row['source_metrics_sha256']!=source_ref['metrics_sha256']:raise ValueError('Pair source binding changed')
  pair_path=merge.reference_path(row['pair_reference'],within=merge.ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2')
  pair=json.loads(pair_path.read_text()); checked=row['independent_verification']
  if (checked.get('validity',{}).get('acceptance_passed') is not True or any(pair.get(k)!=row.get(k) for k in ('scene','kind','pair_id','target_w0','target_w1'))):raise ValueError('Published positive scientific identity mismatch')
  identity=merge.proposal_identity(pair)
  if row['proposal_identity']!=identity or checked['proposal_identity']!=identity:raise ValueError('Original proposal identity changed')
  image=merge.reference_path(row['review_image'],within=pair_path.parent)
  item={k:copy.deepcopy(row[k]) for k in ('scene','kind','pair_id','journal_index','proposal_identity','target_w0','target_w1','pair_reference','review_image','source_file')}
  item.update(checkpoint=checkpoint_ref,source=source_ref,field_of_view=source['config'].get('field_of_view'),independent_construction_acceptance=True,full_T02_acceptance=None)
  verified=checked.get('fixed_labels_verified')
  if verified is not None:
   expected=labels.pair_fields(pair['pair_id'],pair['identities']['candidate_names'])
   for value in (pair,verified):
    if any(value.get(k)!=v for k,v in expected.items()):raise ValueError('Current fixed-label proof mismatch')
   labels.validate_fields(source['config'])
   if item['field_of_view']!=60:raise ValueError('Unexpected fixed-label non60 Look checkpoint; do not silently omit it')
   item.update(fixed_label_version=labels.VERSION,candidate_label_assignment=expected['candidate_label_assignment'])
   current.append(item)
  else:
   if pair.get('fixed_label_version') is not None:raise ValueError('Fixed-label pair lacks independent fixed-label proof')
   item.update(fixed_label_version=None,exclusion_reason='historical spatial labels; never upgraded to current fixed-object-label standard')
   historical.append(item)
selected,surplus,duplicates=merge.balanced_selection(current)
unique=sorted(selected+surplus,key=lambda item:(merge.scene_number(item['scene']),item['journal_index'],item['source_file']))
hselected,hsurplus,hduplicates=merge.balanced_selection(historical)
old='results/t01v2_checkpoint_flip_geometry_01.json'; new='results/t01v2_checkpoint_stay_visible_01.json'
old_rows=[row for row in current if row['checkpoint']['file']==old];new_rows=[row for row in current if row['checkpoint']['file']==new]
old_ids={row['proposal_identity'] for row in old_rows};new_ids={row['proposal_identity'] for row in new_rows}
comparison={'old_checkpoint':old,'new_checkpoint':new,'old_published_look':len(old_rows),'new_published_look':len(new_rows),'old_unique_proposals':len(old_ids),'new_unique_proposals':len(new_ids),'overlap_proposal_identities':sorted(old_ids&new_ids),'cross_round_unique_look':len(old_ids|new_ids),'scope':'unchanged merge.proposal_identity and balanced_selection, with original ordered w0/w1 positions; no arithmetic sum or alternative dedup rule'}
report={'observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'all ended independently published Look checkpoint candidates visible in this repository snapshot; construction acceptance only, no complete-view-table acceptance implied',
 'definition':'src.tools.merge_pair_v2.proposal_identity plus unchanged balanced_selection conflict checks',
 'checkpoint_scan':scan,'comparison':comparison,'current_standard':{'field_of_view':60,'fixed_label_version':labels.VERSION,'unique_count':len(unique),'by_class':dict(Counter(row['kind'] for row in unique)),'pairs':unique,'duplicate_occurrences':duplicates,'all_occurrences':current},
 'historical_not_current':{'unique_count':len(hselected+hsurplus),'by_class':dict(Counter(row['kind'] for row in hselected+hsurplus)),'pairs':hselected+hsurplus,'duplicates':hduplicates,'scope':'historical nonfixed labels; reported separately, not included in current standard'},
 'source_artifacts_modified':False,'thresholds_changed':False}
folder=merge.ROOT/'logs/review'/name;folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
manifest=folder/'current_look_inventory.json'
with manifest.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
markdown=folder/'report.md'
lines=['# Current independently verified Look inventory','',report['scope']+'.','',
 'Cross-round comparison: '+json.dumps(comparison,sort_keys=True)+'.','',
 'Current fixed-label unique counts: '+json.dumps(report['current_standard']['by_class'],sort_keys=True)+'. Historical nonfixed-label unique counts: '+json.dumps(report['historical_not_current']['by_class'],sort_keys=True)+'.','',
 '| Proposal identity | Class | Scene / pair | Checkpoint | Pair source |','|---|---|---|---|---|']
for row in unique:lines.append('| '+row['proposal_identity']+' | '+row['kind']+' | '+row['scene']+' / '+row['pair_id']+' | '+row['checkpoint']['file']+' | '+row['pair_reference']['file']+' |')
with markdown.open('x') as stream:stream.write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
summary={'manifest':{'file':str(manifest.relative_to(merge.ROOT)),'sha256':merge.sha_file(manifest)},'report':{'file':str(markdown.relative_to(merge.ROOT)),'sha256':merge.sha_file(markdown)},'comparison':comparison,'current_unique':len(unique),'current_by_class':report['current_standard']['by_class'],'historical_unique':report['historical_not_current']['unique_count'],'historical_by_class':report['historical_not_current']['by_class'],'current_pairs':[{'pair_id':r['pair_id'],'source':r['source_file'],'checkpoint':r['checkpoint']['file'],'proposal_identity':r['proposal_identity'],'pair_reference':r['pair_reference']} for r in unique]}
print('CURRENT_LOOK_INVENTORY_SUMMARY: '+json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
with (merge.ROOT/'STATUS.md').open('a') as stream:
 stream.write('\n\nCurrent Look inventory (`'+name+'`): original proposal_identity dedup gives '+str(len(unique))+' unique 60-degree fixed-object-label Look pairs, '+json.dumps(report['current_standard']['by_class'],sort_keys=True)+'. Across the geometry/Stay checkpoints: '+str(len(old_rows))+' and '+str(len(new_rows))+' published Look entries, '+str(len(old_ids&new_ids))+' overlapping proposal identities, '+str(len(old_ids|new_ids))+' unique union. Historical nonfixed-label Look remains separate: '+str(report['historical_not_current']['unique_count'])+'. Exact checkpoint/source/pair references are in ['+name+'](logs/review/'+name+'/report.md) and its current_look_inventory.json. Complete-view-table acceptance is not implied; no rule changed.\n')
